name: Engineer's Fang

description.content: [Possessed Chains] injure healthy Survivors, but do not bind them or spawn additional [Chains].
Increases the time to close the [Gateway] after hitting a healthy Survivor with a [Possessed Chain] by [50%].
Hitting an injured Survivor with a [Possessed Chain] only spawns [1] additional [Chain].

quote: "We have such sights to show you." -Pinhead
